acceptance_results.evidence: v0.2 diff only changes Gallery/session iterable compatibility and probe; prechange snapshots and v0.1 report/manifest preserved. No UI, layout, assets, Scene/Prefab or environment helper edits.

acceptance_results.criterion: 提供per-page loadPageResource/releasePageResource给U01/U05，legacy原工程维持原资源路径行为，生产路径不回退隐藏加载错误；准确源码及验证交Tech，实际集成由父Task统一CLI/IAB。

assumptions: This is an authorized runtime defect repair within the existing Gallery Client task; no new product behavior is introduced.
